name: Visual Run-on Sentence
description: Cramming multiple conflicting actions into one shot without cutting.
fix: Cut the action into separate shots, assigning one dramatic verb per shot.

name: Talking Heads
description: Characters delivering dialogue statically without physical subtext.
fix: Assign a physical task or line of action that reveals the character's internal emotion.

name: Twinning
description: Perfectly symmetrical arms, legs, or facial features in an extreme pose.
fix: Offset timing by 2-4 frames or break symmetry to shift weight to one side.

name: Missing the Recoil (Weightless)
description: Character moves linearly from contact to passing without a Down breakdown.
fix: Insert a Down breakdown pose where gravity compresses the character's mass.

name: Unmotivated Camera Roaming
description: Camera drifts or spins without being driven by character motion or story reveal.
fix: Lock the camera down. Only pan/truck if the character moves or a new narrative clue must be revealed.

name: Dead Holds
description: Frozen extremes with no life in the hold.
fix: Use an 8-12 frame minimum moving hold after major poses.

name: Straight-Line Paths
description: Wrists, nose, or hips travel in mechanical straight lines.
fix: Rebuild inbetweens so primary masses travel on arcs.

name: No Anticipation
description: Fast hits arrive without wind-up, so actions feel abrupt and weightless.
fix: Add proportional anticipation before 1-3 frame accents.

name: No Cushioning
description: Actions stop with linear mechanical inbetweens and no settle.
fix: Ease out into aftermath with cushion frames.

name: Late Eyes
description: Head turns before the eyes, so thought does not read.
fix: Lead with eyes/eyelids 2-4 frames before the head.

name: Crossed Axis
description: Coverage jumps across the 180-degree line without re-establishment.
fix: Stay on one side, or insert a neutral/tracking bridge shot.

name: Eyeline Mismatch
description: Reverse shots do not reverse look direction.
fix: If A looks screen-right, B must look screen-left in reverse.

name: Effect Before Cause
description: Reaction appears before the triggering action.
fix: Cut to cause first, then effect/reaction.

name: Weak Silhouette
description: Attitude and line of action disappear when filled black.
fix: Push asymmetry, clearer LOA, and staged overlaps for readable silhouette.

name: Competing Focal Points
description: Multiple equal-strength points fight for attention in one shot.
fix: Reduce to one idea; restage or cut competing action into another shot.
